readiness.conclusion: Not HTTP-listen-only. Initial runtime reload is awaited. Does not issue a D1/R2 health transaction, but multipart test already exercises DB auth, create, R2 upload and seal before the late failure. No basis for arbitrary sleeps or retries.

diagnostic: On 500, getLogs() is reduced immediately to fixed categories and counts. No original message, body, URL, cookie or secret is printed. No 500 is retried or accepted.
remaining: Exact network-disconnection cause and process liveness at failure remain unconfirmed. Source review does not justify application or binding changes.
